column3: Manami Route ・ Manami's Crucial Decision
Kirino-chan, I...
I, like Kyou-chan more than, Japanese sweets...!
Huuuh?!
Even if I couldn't eat Japanese sweets for the rest of my life, that's fine! That's how much I like Kyou-chan...!
...I see. Then there's nothing more I have to say.
Kirino-chan...
I'll go get manjuu in the storefront. You two talk it out until I get back.
So it's all settled now?! What's with these two and their telepathy?!
It's your problem and it was to begin with. It doesn't even concern me.
...I only dealt with it because you said "Life counseling". I've repaid my debt. See ya.
...And she's gone.
So now, Manami and I are here, together... alone...
...This is awkward.
Awkward but... I'll have to manage somehow.
Say Manami, I know I came over here all of a sudden, but will you listen to what I have to say?
Y-Yes, what is it?
I said something awful to you. "Become the future Manami".
When I told Kirino, she got really mad.
I... see...  And then, Kirino-chan came here and...
Even so, you and me, never changed. Those are the words I thought about.
It was just so nice and comfortable, I thought... if only it could be like that forever...
However, Kirino told me and I finally realized I asked you to change for my sake.
Kyou-chan...
I'm in no place to impose on you with my request. I should change myself as well.
I was just trying to force my own ideals on you.
T-That's not true...
No, it is.
Because you were crying... right? That day we talked in the park...
At that time, I might have made a mistake and shrugged it off, but now seeing Manami on the verge of tears, I'm convinced that can only be it.
With my own ego, I hurt my dear childhood friend, I made her cry...
Everything, it was all my fault. I'm really sorry!
Ky-Kyou-chan?
But, listen to me a little longer!
For always being considerate towards me, thank you.
Just apologizing isn't sincere. There's something I noticed about what Kirino told me.
Despite always causing trouble for Manami, I never actually thanked her in a proper manner.
It's so obvious that I actually never realized it...
You being by my side, I realized it's something I'm really grateful for.
Just like Kirino said, I'm an idiot, and I might also be thickheaded but...
Stay by my side from now on as well and let me continue expressing my gratitude.
Ky-Kyou-chan...
Manami's eyes glistened... was she moved by what I said...?
Atchou!
What a grand sneeze.
Awww... nnngg, *sniffle*
K-Kyou-chan, sorry... I couldn't hold it back anymore...
Eh? Ah... don't...
M-My once in a lifetime confession... With a sneeze...!
Wait, are you actually sick?
Y-Yes. It seems like I caught a summer cold.
But, I did tell Kyou-chan that I caught a cold right?
Y-You did but...
Skipping school like that, of course I'd think you were faking it!
So that means... So far, that red face... Those teary eyes...
All of it... Was because of her cold!?
HAAAAAAaaaahhhh...
W-What's wrong? You suddenly resemble an old man, Kyou-chan!
I'm just worn out...
Whose fault is it... Goes without saying.
Though only half of it, feels like my just desserts.
Kyou-chan～
What?
About what you said earlier...
I... can't stay by your side now.
Huh? W-Why!
Well, because, you'd catch my cold～
Ah... That's what you meant...
Oh... My chest's hurting, and my head is going *boom*.
A cold, where I can only think about Kyou-chan.
Manami? That means...
Kyou-chan... doesn't have to change～
No matter what kind of Kyou-chan it is, I'll properly look after him!
Seriously... She's a lost cause!
Really, that girl's problem is, she's not happy if she can't look after me.
In that case, I'll also be by your side!
This "Clueless" cold of yours, give it to me!
Huh?
No problem, right?
Hehe... Stupid Kyou-chan.
It feels like the mood has lightened.
Yes, this is the usual "warmth" between Manami and me. The mood that I wanted to last forever.
Kyou-chan, let's get along from now on as well!
Yeah! Same here, let's get along even as we grow old!
Eh? U-Until we grow old... That's... Errr...
Is that a no?
N-No! Kyou-chan... Let's always... Always get along!
